create_NRGBD_dataset: create an NRGBD dataset instance with a ROOT path, num_seq, and num_frames parameters
load_poses_from_file: load camera poses from a poses.txt file and return a numpy array of 4x4 matrices
get_views_for_scene: get views with rgb images, depthmaps, camera poses, and intrinsics for a given scene index
load_tuples_from_path: load a list of scene-image tuples from a text file for use in the NRGBD dataset
sample_frames_from_sequence: sample frames from a video sequence using min and max threshold constraints with optional reversal
